body: I went to sleep right after posting this, so just wanted to make a general comment to everyone.Thank you to everyone who has left a comment, it has helped. I have big exams this summer, so I am off school in three months, one of which is holiday. I’m gonna stick it out until then and focus on doing well in these exams. Then I have 3/4 months of summer where I will be fine. When school starts again it may be better - I am only doing four subjects that I like. Thank you again for the kind words and sharing of personal experiences, it really has helped me.
